files.bookmarks.json: array of {id, device_id, mcq_id, created_at}; addBookmark dedupes on (mcq_id, device_id)
files.history.json: array of {id, device_id, mcq_id, correct, points, mode, answered_at, time_taken_sec, skipped, session_id}
files.leaderboard.json: keyed by device_id: {id, device_id, name, points, week_key, month_key, correct, total, week_claimed, month_claimed, updated_at}
files.periods.json: array of {device_id, period, period_key, points, correct, total, updated_at} for daily/weekly/monthly/yearly

sqlite_semantics_mirrored.scoring: correct -> +10 points; skipped flag; time clamped 0..3600; mode capped 40 chars; session_id int
sqlite_semantics_mirrored.leaderboard_sort: points DESC, correct DESC, device_id ASC, top 100

notes.write_strategy: whole-file rewrite on each mutation (JSON.stringify 1-space); single-process assumption — no file locking
notes.idempotency: recordAnswer appends unconditionally (mirrors INSERT); bookmarks dedupe (mirrors guarded INSERT)
notes.spaced_revision: AI engine schedules stay SQLite (NOT_MIGRATED — 501 under SQLITE_DISABLED)
notes.verification: parity: bookmarks get/post, history get/post correct/wrong/bad, leaderboard, analytics + after-write rechecks PASS; regression PASS
